sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
 For the Petitioners : Mr. Kaushik Sarkhel, Adv.
 For the State : Mr. Pankaj Kumar, P.P.
 ....
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The applicants who are in custody since 19.10.2022 have approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S. Case No.06 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 414/ 419/ 420/ 467/ 468/ 471/ 120B of IPC and Section 66(B)(C)(D) of I.T. Act.

entities.text: Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S. Case No.06 of 2022
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicants are an accused of committing cyber crime.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of F.I.R. alongwith its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his part.
Innocence have been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.

It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that the applicants have been roped in on the basis of confession of the co-accused and the apprehended co-accused has already been enlarged on bail.
On above basis prayer for bail has been made.
Learned P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicants.

Considering the above fact, the applicants, named above, are directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand only) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-I, Jamtara in connection with Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S. Case No.06 of 2022, subject to the conditions that the applicants will submit self attested copy of their Aadhaar Card and also give their mobile number before the learned court below which they will not change during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

entities.text: Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S. Case No.06 of 2022
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Further, one of the bailors will be the father of the applicants and the applicants are directed to report once in a month to the concerned police station.
